notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR8: "In the Report Section, the USAGE clause is used only to declare the usage of printable items": a. in a format 3 entry "that entry must define a printable item"; b. in a format 1 or format 2 entry at least one subordinate entry must. ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryFormats (85 only) refuses USAGE on a PICTURE (format 3) entry with no COLUMN clause, and on a level-01 or format 2 entry none of whose subordinates (any depth, up to the next entry at its level) has a COLUMN clause, COBOL2247; #ScreenReportUsage keeps the usage to DISPLAY (NATIONAL is gated 2002). Probes at 85: refused the witness (SUM counter TOT with USAGE DISPLAY, no COLUMN), USAGE on an 01 over only a sum counter, on a format 2 entry over only a sum counter, USAGE COMP on a counter (plus COBOL2198), USAGE written twice (COBOL2423), USAGE NATIONAL (COBOL0900); accepted and printed 00005 with USAGE on a COLUMN SUM entry, on an 01 or 02 over a COLUMN entry, on a COLUMN SOURCE entry. At 2002 USAGE on the 01 over a counter compiles.

next.reason: 1985: in the Report Section USAGE (DISPLAY only) may appear only on an entry that defines, or has a subordinate that defines, a printable item. 2023 §2023:13.18.60.3 SR7 says only 'Only the DISPLAY or NATIONAL phrase may be specified in any USAGE clause associated with a report group item'; no 2023 rule ties USAGE to a printable item (one with a COLUMN clause, §2023:13.18.14.4 GR1). So USAGE DISPLAY on an unprintable entry, refused in 1985, is accepted, and NATIONAL is added. Looser.
